item.title: Rob Schneider will bring his stand-up tour to Philadelphia in April
item.description: Comedian and actor Rob Schneider will return to Rivers Casino Philadelphia this spring for a stand-up show at The Event Center.

item.title: Outstanding teachers can be nominated to receive a VIP package from the Phillies and IBX
item.description: Six teachers in the Philadelphia area will receive VIP packages from the Phillies for being named to the Independence Blue Cross Honor Roll this year. Nominations can be submitted through March 22, 2026.

item.title: Brew N’ History Tour will bring beer and Revolutionary stories to Christ Church Burial Ground
item.description: Philadelphia’s revolutionary history is getting a little more spirited.

item.title: The Flyers can't get delusional about this trade deadline
item.description: The Flyers aren't out of the race yet, but with Rasmus Ristolainen's stock at possibly it's highest and the playoffs still a long shot, maybe it is best to sell one more time.

item.title: Becoming an expert birdwatcher may help protect the brain from aging
item.description: The identification skills of birdwatchers is associated with improved cognitive health over a lifetime, according to new research out of Canada. Expertise in identifying species is linked to structural differences in regions of the brain used for attention, perception and working memory.

item.title: Ocean County car crash leaves 3 dead, 1 in hospital
item.description: Three people died in a car crash Sunday night in Ocean County. A Ford Bronco collided head-on with a Toyota Sienna on Pinehurst Road in Plumsted Township. The driver and passengers of the Siena were pronounced dead on the scene.

item.title: The original Phillie Phanatic brings the 'Evolution of Happiness' to Tri-State HRMA’s 39th Annual Conference
item.description: When people think of the Phillie Phanatic, they visualize energy, enthusiasm, and unforgettable moments, qualities rarely associated with professional development events. But what if those very qualities could be harnessed to transform workplace culture, boost engagement, and inspire teams to perform at their very best?

item.title: MudHen Brewing to host three-day Blues, Brews & Country Festival in Wildwood
item.description: Wildwood may still be in its quiet season, but MudHen Brewing Company is turning up the volume for one weekend in March.

item.title: For botanical artist Tu Bloom, 'mistakes make perfection' in floral arrangements
item.description: Tu Bloom, who is hosting potting parties at the Philadelphia Flower Show, is also behind the red carpet florals at the Grammy Awards. He shared his tips on arranging, why he loves plants and the behind-the-scenes of his celebrity gig.

item.title: Benito, a raccoon rescued by South Philly neighbors during cold spell, is on the mend at a busy wildlife center
item.description: A raccoon named Benito that was rescued by neighbors in South Philly is on the road to recovery at Raven Ridge Wildlife Center in Lancaster County after braving the elements of the cold stretch that gripped the region this winter.
